metadata.dataset: Greek myth entities and social context
metadata.scope: Entities discussed in this conversation, expanded with key related figures; not every ancient Greek god or nymph

fields.powers: Mythic capabilities described in cited traditions, not real-world claims
fields.weaknesses_or_limits: Documented vulnerabilities or narrative constraints; not necessarily universal
fields.evidence_level: high=clear ancient narrative, medium=source variants or interpretive, low=later taxonomy or weak attestation

caveats: Symbol associations vary by era and artwork.
Associated god does not imply control over all members of a nymph class.
Sirens are not historically classified into distinct species like water/forest nymphs.
Nymph classes overlap and some listed types are late or poorly attested.
Social categories are not supernatural affiliations.
Reproductive allegories are modern interpretive mappings unless a source explicitly attests them.
Name interpretations are morphological proposals and can be uncertain; named Sirens belong to conflicting ancient lists.
metadata.changes: Expanded etymologies, transliterations, signature narratives, manifestations, social-class evidence caveats, and individually named Sirens/nymphs.
metadata.source_validation: Passage references are bibliographic leads, not newly verified against critical editions. No invented powers for name-only figures.
metadata.image_policy: Image manifest contains no claimed downloads. Supply licensed/verified images with artifact metadata.
metadata.training_guidance: Use as retrieval corpus, not uncritically as fine-tuning ground truth. Filter unverified and low-confidence assertions.
